rows.text:
# Transformation Milestone: Stage 1

The heat that had been building intensifies suddenly—your entire body erupts in perspiration. Sweat pours from every pore, soaking through your clothes in seconds. Your skin feels like it's burning from within, radiating warmth that makes the air around you seem thick and humid.

Then comes the pallor—a visible draining of color from your face, neck, and arms. You can see it spreading across your skin like a wash of cold white paint, leaving behind a ghostly, unhealthy pallor. The contrast between your flushed, overheated body and your whitening skin creates an unsettling visual effect.

Your muscles begin to ache—deep, persistent pains that settle into your joints and make even small movements feel labored. Your bones feel heavy, resistant to motion. The discomfort spreads throughout your entire body, a pervasive weakness that makes you want to collapse onto the nearest surface.

Finally, your skin becomes hypersensitive—every touch of fabric against your sweat-soaked body sends shivers of irritation racing across your nerve endings. The sensation is maddening, impossible to ignore as moisture clings to every inch of your flesh.

Throughout all of this, any arousal that might have been building vanishes completely, leaving you physically drained and emotionally flat as your body processes these intense changes.

rows.speaker: Game result
rows.text:
# Transformation Milestone: Stage 2

The pressure begins deep in your feet—a strange, insistent stretching sensation that starts at your toes and radiates back through your arches. Your socks suddenly feel tight, constricting around expanding digits. There's no pain, just an intense awareness of growth happening beneath your skin.

Your feet spread wider, longer—each toe extending fractionally as the bones lengthen and reshape. The soles press against the floor as the entire foot plate expands downward and outward. You can feel the transformation working through the delicate arch structure, the heel, the ball of your foot.

Within moments, your shoes no longer fit properly—the toes now pressed uncomfortably against the front interior. The width has increased noticeably; when you shift your weight, the altered proportions are immediately apparent.

*Milestone recorded: Foot size US women's size 5.*

The physiological climax that accompanied this change now passes—a wave of intensity that floods through your nervous system before abruptly cutting off. Arousal resets to baseline.

rows.speaker: Game result
rows.text:
# Transformation Milestone: Stage 3

The sensation begins as a deep pressure in your thighs—a warm, insistent expansion that feels like blood rushing to fill newly forming flesh. Your skin stretches taut across the expanding muscle and adipose tissue beneath.

The growth spreads upward from your knees, traveling along the femoral region in both directions—thickening outward and rounding the contours of your upper legs. You can feel each inch of expansion as fat deposits accumulate, creating soft, pillowy tissue that presses against the fabric of your clothes.

Your thighs swell outward until they reach proportions matching your widened hips—full, substantial, feminine curves that shift and sway with even minor movements. The underlying muscle remains relatively light but defined enough to provide subtle shape beneath the predominant fatty tissue.

Lower down, your calves respond similarly—expanding outward into fuller, more rounded forms. The tissue softens and smooths as additional fat deposits accumulate around existing muscle fibers, creating a gently toned appearance.

rows.speaker: Body / Senses
rows.text:
# Body Awareness

You reach down tentatively, your fingers brushing against the smooth expanse of your inner thigh. The flesh yields easily under gentle pressure—soft and pliant, carrying noticeable weight that shifts with even slight movements.

The outer thigh feels firmer, more structured beneath the layer of fat. Your fingertips trace along what must be muscle definition, though it's considerably muted compared to what you remember. Everything feels... different. Heavier. The fullness extends down to your calves as well—when you touch them, they're noticeably rounder and denser than before.

A mild ache pulses through the muscles as you maintain contact, reminding you that this is still part of being unwell. The skin itself feels slightly warm to the touch, perhaps a bit clammy in places where sweat has started to gather.

Your hand rests there for a moment longer before you withdraw it, left with a vivid impression of just how much your lower body has changed overnight.

rows.text:
# Central Hub NE - Tue · 07:03

Your words drift unanswered across the quiet park. The morning air remains still—no response comes from the scattered benches or flower beds.

The bodily sensations persist unchanged: that persistent overheating, the dull ache in your limbs, the uncomfortable tightness of skin that seems increasingly sensitive to every shift and movement.

No one approaches. The park sits empty in this early hour, grass damp with dew beneath your feet.

The illness continues its course—stage three of fourteen, according to what you've experienced so far.
